# nationality

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:nationality`](gmeow-nationality.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/nationality>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/entities`](../../slices/entities.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The country of a person's nationality ([schema:nationality](https://schema.org/nationality)) — a [`gmeow:Place`](../classes/gmeow-Place.md). The legal/national-identity bond, distinct from where a person currently lives. Non-functional: a person may hold several nationalities; contested cases are standpoint-indexed claims ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record a person's legal national-identity bond to a country — the [schema:nationality](https://schema.org/nationality) relation, pointing at a [`gmeow:Place`](../classes/gmeow-Place.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid for where a person currently lives or is located (model residence/location separately); nationality is the legal bond, not the dwelling place.

### How to use

- Point the person at a country [`gmeow:Place`](../classes/gmeow-Place.md); it is non-functional, so multiple nationalities coexist, and a contested nationality is carried as a gmeow:accordingTo-indexed standpoint claim rather than a single asserted fact ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
